headline: Ten drivers give up their cars for Mexico FP1
body: Verstappen, Norris and Russell are among ten regulars replaced in first practice by rookies, with Iwasa, Fornaroli and Vesti taking their cars. Only Ferrari runs both full-time drivers. The sessions after FP1 are unaffected.

headline: Mexico gets resurfaced asphalt and a C3/C4/C5 tyre selection
body: Pirelli brings the C3 as hard, C4 as medium and C5 as soft. A large part of the circuit has been resurfaced, from Turn 7 to Turn 1, with only the first sector largely unchanged. Pirelli expects a one-stop race to be possible, with graining and early-session grip evolution to watch.

headline: Mexico City forecast: mostly dry, with a 20% chance of rain for qualifying
body: Friday has a 30% chance of rain, Saturday afternoon and evening 20%, and Sunday's race looks dry with 0% and track temperatures up to 45C. Highs run from 25C to 27C.
